data.title: Unpack and Share
data.description: Set known weight aside on both sides, then share what remains among the parcels.

challenges.instruction: Set known weight aside on both sides, then share what remains among the parcels.
challenges.hint: Use the current weight task. Keep equal amounts together and use one group per identical parcel.
